request.text: 请修订装配插入步骤，只返回严格JSON对象 {"schema":"anatomy.steps-repair.v1","steps":[...]}。每个step保持part/instruction/direction/distance四字段。严禁更改任何零件尺寸、mate/gap或新增零件。direction是从终点指向起点：start=final+direction*distance，插入运动方向与direction相反。螺栓头位于+Z，杆沿-Z；从法兰正面插入的起点应该在法兰+Z外侧。每件必须出现一次且父先子后；可以调整顺序、从轴的两端选择方向，避免穿过已经装好的大直径零件。距离0..300mm。静态装配已无体积干涉；七点采样发现的实际障碍如下，先根据明确几何关系修订步骤，不需要重新推导热力学或长篇解释。{"parts":[{"id":"shaft","kind":"shaft","material":"steel","name":"主传动轴","params":{"diameter":20,"length":180},"position":[0,0,0],"rotation":[0,0,0]},{"id":"bearing","kind":"bearing","material":"steel","name":"支撑深沟球轴承","params":{"inner":20.2,"length":14,"outer":47},"position":[0,0,0],"rotation":[0,0,0]},{"id":"spacer-a","kind":"tube","material":"bronze","name":"轴承后定位隔套","params":{"inner":20.4,"length":16,"outer":28},"position":[0,0,0],"rotation":[0,0,0]},{"id":"spacer-b","kind":"tube","material":"bronze","name":"轴承前定位隔套","params":{"inner":20.4,"length":16,"outer":28},"position":[0,0,0],"rotation":[0,0,0]},{"id":"flange","kind":"flange","material":"steel","name":"前端固定带孔法兰","params":{"bolt_circle":50,"bolt_diameter":6.4,"bolts":4,"inner":20.4,"outer":80,"thickness":10},"position":[0,0,0],"rotation":[0,0,0]},{"id":"bolt-a","kind":"bolt","material":"steel","name":"法兰紧固螺栓-A","params":{"diameter":5.8,"head_diameter":10,"head_height":5,"length":25},"position":[0,0,0],"rotation":[0,0,0]},{"id":"bolt-b","kind":"bolt","material":"steel","name":"法兰紧固螺栓-B","params":{"diameter":5.8,"head_diameter":10,"head_height":5,"length":25},"position":[0,0,0],"rotation":[0,0,0]}],"mates":[{"child_port":"axis","fit":"clearance","gap":-30,"joint":"revolute","parent":"shaft","parent_port":"axis","part":"bearing","twist":0},{"child_port":"axis","fit":"clearance","gap":-50,"joint":"fixed","parent":"shaft","parent_port":"axis","part":"spacer-a","twist":0},{"child_port":"axis","fit":"clearance","gap":-10,"joint":"fixed","parent":"shaft","parent_port":"axis","part":"spacer-b","twist":0},{"child_port":"axis","fit":"clearance","gap":40,"joint":"fixed","parent":"shaft","parent_port":"axis","part":"flange","twist":0},{"child_port":"axis","fit":"clearance","gap":5,"joint":"fixed","parent":"flange","parent_port":"bolt-0","part":"bolt-a","twist":0},{"child_port":"axis","fit":"clearance","gap":5,"joint":"fixed","parent":"flange","parent_port":"bolt-2","part":"bolt-b","twist":0}],"steps":[{"direction":[0,0,1],"distance":0,"instruction":"将主传动轴基准固定于装配工位。","part":"shaft"},{"direction":[0,0,-1],"distance":80,"instruction":"自轴端沿负Z向推入后定位隔套A至轴向预设位置。","part":"spacer-a"},{"direction":[0,0,-1],"distance":70,"instruction":"自轴端沿负Z向安装深沟球轴承，贴靠隔套端面。","part":"bearing"},{"direction":[0,0,-1],"distance":60,"instruction":"自轴端滑入前定位隔套B，完成轴承轴向夹持定位。","part":"spacer-b"},{"direction":[0,0,1],"distance":70,"instruction":"自轴正向端推入法兰盘，对齐轴心并推至指定间隙位置。","part":"flange"},{"direction":[0,0,-1],"distance":40,"instruction":"将螺栓A自正向插入法兰第0号螺栓孔，使螺栓头肩面贴合法兰外端面。","part":"bolt-a"},{"direction":[0,0,-1],"distance":40,"instruction":"将螺栓B自正向插入法兰第2号螺栓孔，使螺栓头肩面贴合法兰外端面。","part":"bolt-b"}],"insertion":{"status":"sampled_interference","samples_per_step":7,"narrow_phase_pairs":37,"hits":[{"part":"bearing","obstacle":"spacer-a","max_intersection_mm3":3370.510038281369,"remaining_fractions":[0.333333,0.166667]},{"part":"spacer-b","obstacle":"spacer-a","max_intersection_mm3":4622.4137667858795,"remaining_fractions":[0.833333,0.666667,0.5]},{"part":"spacer-b","obstacle":"bearing","max_intersection_mm3":4044.612045937646,"remaining_fractions":[0.5,0.333333,0.166667]},{"part":"bolt-a","obstacle":"flange","max_intersection_mm3":231.84953783492674,"remaining_fractions":[0.333333,0.166667]},{"part":"bolt-b","obstacle":"flange","max_intersection_mm3":231.84953783492674,"remaining_fractions":[0.333333,0.166667]}],"limits":"按声明的直线插入方向、距离和父先子后步骤，在每步7个时刻检查已安装零件；离散采样可能漏过薄障碍物或采样间穿透，不是连续碰撞/扫掠体证明。"}}
